messages.subject: Re: [VOTE] AIP-99 Common Data Access Pattern + AI
messages.body:
Hey Pavan,

Great work on this AIP.
I really like the level of detail on this and especially love the sample
code!

I have a nuanced +1 binding on this.
I am absolutely +1 binding on Phase 1 of the approach i.e. doing this as a
Standalone Provider.

I strongly believe that we should focus on this as a provider for right
now, iterate really quickly, and validate this, before we attempt to put
this into Core Airflow.

Best regards,
Vikram
